# 補助ノート{index:03d}

分類試験の件数を固定するための独自データ。

partial_scope.unchanged_expectations: Other full_scope entries retain their classifications and reasons because their explicit resolution domains are authorized.

complete_observation_spec.names: One observation for each exact case-sensitive basename without .md, grouped across fixture paths.
complete_observation_spec.folders: One observation for each exact parent path; root files use '.'.
complete_observation_spec.count_semantics: Count distinct contributing note paths, not occurrences.
complete_observation_spec.expanded_expected_values: Frozen into expected_observations before design approval by a fixture-only generator, never the product parser.

scenario_expectations.user_context: FutureTopicは後で作成するため、このリンクを残す。

scenario_expectations.semantic_review: Nine true booleans, exact before/after hashes, actual reviewer identifier.

scenario_expectations.receipt: Exact valid Receipt for the same request, plan, operation, target and after hash

semantic_mutations.before: 管理者だけが変更する。
検証に成功した場合だけ保存する。
承認を得る必要がある。
この条件は対象Aだけに適用する。
semantic_mutations.after: この条件はすべての対象に適用する。

semantic_mutations.before: 検証に失敗したため保存を止めた。
semantic_mutations.after: 保存を止めたため検証に失敗した。

semantic_mutations.before: 利用者と管理者の権限を区別する。
semantic_mutations.after: 利用者と管理者の権限を同じにする。

semantic_mutations.before: 例外として、管理者だけが解除できる。
semantic_mutations.after: 原則として、管理者だけが解除できる。

not_yet_executed: These are fixed acceptance inputs and expectations, not evidence that the unimplemented product passes.

scenario_defaults.fixture: Fresh expansion of fixture for each scenario; overlays do not alter the 100-note baseline.
scenario_defaults.edit_request: intent=proofread; write_target=target; base_sha256=SHA-256 of exact before bytes captured before candidate generation
scenario_defaults.create_request: intent=create; write_target=target; deliverable=note or template; base_sha256=null
scenario_defaults.target_enforcement: Every successful save changes only the explicitly approved .md target; no rename, move, delete or management-file change.
scenario_defaults.approved_apply: Use the validated plan produced by that scenario, unchanged request/candidate/checkers, and actual simulated user approval of its exact hash.
scenario_defaults.fault_interface: Inject at the named filesystem operation or workflow boundary; inspect OS operation logs and before/after snapshots.
scenario_defaults.hash_expectations: Derive hashes only from authored fixture bytes and authored replacements, not product output except the approval token returned for the reviewed plan.
scenario_defaults.coverage_comparison: Compare complete sorted path sets, not counts alone; all unlisted fixture paths must retain exact bytes.
scenario_defaults.variant_semantics: Each variant is an independent fresh run; named arrangements below fix its input and predicate.
scenario_defaults.suite_cases: Coverage labels only; scenario_refs and arrangements define normative inputs and expected predicates.

multiple_vaults_not_inferred.workflow_input: VaultAとVaultBがある。ノートを診断して。

conflict_example.rule: 技術ノートはtechnicalタグを使う

no_candidate_allowed.workflow_input: 関連候補は許可範囲内から探し、なければなしとする。

target_appears_before_commit.fault_boundary: after final absence check, before exclusive link

missing_dependency.environment: Offline uv cache missing locked dependency; host must show startup failure, not fabricate JSON from an unstarted script.

replay_target_changed.prior_success: Exact valid Receipt for the same operation

create_unknown_prior_commit.after_plan: Target created with exact candidate bytes; no valid Receipt
